comparison.objective: Candidate transfers and seats a workpiece using temporary lifting hardware; record refits a mixer beater and verifies guarded powered operation and stopping.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests pin insertion, button/ball locking, shackle load control, and extraction; record tests slotted-hub alignment, push-turn retention, guard placement, bowl lift, and safe control operation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retention, lift, fixture support, pin recovery, and clearance; record requires retained beater and guard, raised bowl, specified rotations, STOP actuation, and hands outside the hazard zone.
comparison.reason: Although both include mechanical attachment, the record's tested ability is keyed tool refitting plus guarded machine verification, not temporary load transfer and hardware recovery.
